turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Why do my chocolate chip cookies spread into one giant sheet?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Ha, the cookie puddle. Is your butter very soft, or even melted, when you mix it?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I usually microwave it so it's easy to stir.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's likely it. Use butter that's soft but still cool, and chill the dough for an hour before baking.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: An hour? I want cookies now.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Even twenty minutes in the freezer helps. Also check your baking soda isn't years old.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's probably from when I moved in.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then grab a fresh one. It's cheap and it really does make a difference.
